theme: Open ends around a crowded middle — and two booking windows closing.
greeting: Morning, Dan. It's an open morning and an open evening wrapped around a busy midday. The week's real pressure isn't the calendar, though — it's two travel-booking windows quietly running out of road.

needsAttention.title: December trip still has no destination
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 30 decision date has already slipped and the Oct 15 book-by is a week out. Holiday inventory for six across three weeks is the thinnest of the year — this is the one that bites if it waits.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV isn't held yet
needsAttention.detail: A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out early. It's sat flagged top-priority since mid-September; a refundable hold costs nothing and closes the risk.

needsAttention.title: St Pete Beach signing is on its second notice
needsAttention.detail: A document-signing invitation for the 26th Ave property came through again this morning after a first reminder yesterday, still unsigned.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar until noon — the widest open stretch of the day sits right at the front of it.
The day's weight lands midday: three calls back to back, with board-world and finance both in the mix.
It empties after half past two, and with the girls at Jen's this week the evening is genuinely your own.
